fusions.name: Bearing Down
fusions.desc: Puts the full weight of your plate behind one blow that deals 38 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Heave Them Off
fusions.desc: Throws your weight outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Burst the Bonds
fusions.desc: Strains against your bonds and removes up to 3 conditions from you. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterwards.

fusions.name: Return the Weight
fusions.desc: When you take damage that is not fire, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
